This '''national electoral calendar for 2014''' lists the national/[[Federation|federal]] elections held in 2014 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included.{{Elections}}

==January==
*5 January: [[Elections in Bangladesh|Bangladesh]], [[2014 Bangladeshi general election|Parliament]]
*14–15 January: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2014 Egyptian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://allafrica.com/stories/201312260946.html|title=HEC - Referendum On Schedule, No Intention to Delay|publisher=[[Egypt State Information Service]]|website=[[allAfrica]]|date=26 December 2013|access-date=28 June 2020|archive-date=13 July 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150713134531/http://allafrica.com/stories/201312260946.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
*23 January: ''[[Politics of Tokelau|Tokelau]], [[2014 Tokelauan general election|Legislature]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.scoop.co.nz/stories/WO1401/S00295/tokelau-2014-election-underway.htm|title=Tokelau 2014 Election Underway|website=[[Scoop (website)|Scoop]]|date=23 January 2014|access-date=10 July 2020|archive-date=7 September 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200907112538/https://www.scoop.co.nz/stories/WO1401/S00295/tokelau-2014-election-underway.htm|url-status=live}}</ref>

==February==
*2 February: 
**[[Elections in Costa Rica|Costa Rica]], [[2014 Costa Rican general election|President and Parliament]]<ref name="Costa-Rica">{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-26010248|title=Costa Rica holds presidential elections|work=[[BBC News]]|date=3 February 2014|access-date=20 June 2018|archive-date=13 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190513091956/https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-26010248|url-status=live}}</ref>
**[[Elections in El Salvador|El Salvador]], [[2014 Salvadoran presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref name="El-Salvador">{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-26007273|title=El Salvador vote counting under way|work=[[BBC News]]|date=3 February 2014|access-date=20 June 2018|archive-date=29 January 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190129082246/https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-26007273|url-status=live}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Thailand|Thailand]], [[2014 Thai general election|<s>House of Representatives</s>]] (election nullified)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2014/03/21/thai-court-rules-february-election-invalid|title=Thai court rules February election invalid|work=[[Special Broadcasting Service|SBS]]|date=21 March 2014|access-date=28 June 2020|archive-date=4 March 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304212538/http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2014/03/21/thai-court-rules-february-election-invalid|url-status=live}}</ref>
*9 February: [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2014 Swiss referendums#February referendums|Referendums]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2014/02/10/world/europe/swiss-voters-narrowly-approve-curbs-on-immigration.html|work=[[The New York Times]]|first=Melissa|last=Eddy|title=Swiss Voters Narrowly Approve Curbs on Immigration|date=9 February 2014|access-date=27 February 2017|archive-date=29 May 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160529230729/http://www.nytimes.com/2014/02/10/world/europe/swiss-voters-narrowly-approve-curbs-on-immigration.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
*20 February: [[Elections in Libya|Libya]], [[2014 Libyan Constitutional Assembly election|Constitutional Assembly]]<ref>{{cite web|author=Hadi Fornaji|title=Elections for 60-member Constitutional Committee on 20 February|url=http://www.libyaherald.com/2014/01/30/elections-for-60-member-constitutional-committee-on-20-february/|newspaper=[[Libya Herald]]|location=[[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]]|date=30 January 2014|access-date=1 February 2014|archive-date=1 February 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140201214422/http://www.libyaherald.com/2014/01/30/elections-for-60-member-constitutional-committee-on-20-february/|url-status=live}}</ref>

**[[Elections in El Salvador|El Salvador]], [[2014 Salvadoran presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref name="El-Salvador"/>
**[[Elections in North Korea|North Korea]], [[2014 North Korean parliamentary election|Parliament]]

**''[[Republic of Crimea (Russia)|Crimea]], [[2014 Crimean status referendum|Russian Annexation Referendum]]''

*22 March: [[Elections in the Maldives|Maldives]], [[2014 Maldivian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |date=10 March 2014 |title=Maldives court sacks elections officials for disobedience |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/world/maldives-court-sacks-elections-officials-for-disobedience-idUSBREA2900N/ |work=[[Reuters]]}}</ref>

**[[Elections in India|India]], [[2014 Indian general election|House of the People (5th phase)]]{{cn|date=June 2026}}

News]]|access-date=14 January 2017|archive-date=5 March 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160305043004/http://news.yahoo.com/macedonian-parliament-dissolved-early-election-145853771.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

**[[Elections in Guinea-Bissau|Guinea-Bissau]], [[2014 Guinea-Bissau general election|President (2nd round)]]<ref name="BBC-GuineaBissau"/>
**[[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2014 Swiss referendums#May referendums|Referendums]]

**[[Elections in Belgium|Belgium]], [[2014 Belgian federal election|Chamber of Representatives]]
**[[Elections in Colombia|Colombia]], [[2014 Colombian presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref name="BBC-Colombia">{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-27567604|title=Colombia election: Santos to face Zuluaga in run-off|work=[[BBC News]]|date=26 May 2014|access-date=28 June 2020|archive-date=12 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201112034303/https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-27567604|url-status=live}}</ref>
